caption.text: From text to execution. The first three layers analyse; the intermediate representation is where the virtual machine and native code part ways.

rows.text: tree with types and names resolved

runs.text: (IR) is the central piece. Every statement is marked with an entry and an exit, and every decision with its branch: that way execution can account for exactly what happens. Translating to the IR
: running it gives the same outputs, in the same order, the language prescribes.

blocks.title: A small program

points.text: The engine works in layers: lexical, syntax, semantics, IR and execution.
The IR marks statements and decisions so execution is observable.
Translating to the IR keeps the meaning.
